data.one_liner: A time-based one-time password (TOTP) and HOTP authentication package for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Generates and verifies time-based (TOTP) and counter-based (HOTP) one-time passwords, creates secret keys, parses otpauth:// URIs, and aids with QR code generation.
use_when: You need to implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) using authenticator apps like Google Authenticator.
You want to generate and verify TOTP or HOTP codes directly within your Flutter app.
avoid_when: You are looking for external hosted authentication backends like Firebase Auth or Supabase.
You need biometric-only sign-in rather than time-based code verification.
strengths: Supports SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 algorithms.
Includes offline QR code matrix generation for privacy.
Supports backup/recovery codes and URI parsing.
weaknesses: Relies on third-party URL APIs if you use the online QR code generation helper.
Limited to one-time password logic rather than full identity management.
data.setup_notes: No special native permissions or build runner required. Just import and use.
data.minimal_example:
String secret = AuthTOTP.createSecret(length: 16);
bool isValid = AuthTOTP.verifyCode(secretKey: secret, totpCode: '123456');
